scope: Superseded short-run T1/T5 GRPO drafts are replaced for controlled comparison by this planned recipe. T2/T3 retain their original hybrid algorithm and handoff recipe.

alignment_contract.reference_runtime: original PR #18 hybrid stack; do not substitute the old Dual-Track-OPD baseline backend
alignment_contract.common_field_rule: Every common field is copied exactly from the T2/T3 recipe except opsd.grpo_opsd_mode.
alignment_contract.teacher_settings_in_grpo_mode: Inherited for common-field fidelity but inactive: effective lambda is zero and teacher scoring/prompts are disabled.

algorithmic_invariants.advantage: Per-UID GRPO outcome advantage; eight rollouts per group; sample standard deviation with denominator G-1 and epsilon 1e-6.
algorithmic_invariants.loss: Original hybrid stack PPO/GRPO policy loss and distributed valid-response-token reduction, including binary-group rlsd_loss_mask semantics.
algorithmic_invariants.optimizer_updates: At most 400: global steps with no nonzero policy-gradient signal skip the actor optimizer update.

comparison_pairs.T1_T2: Same Base revision and 30k dataset mixture required; only the intended GRPO-versus-hybrid training route should differ.
comparison_pairs.T5_T3: Same 15k RL dataset and public RL configuration; SFT versus MOPD initialization remains an intentional route difference, not an initialization-only ablation.
comparison_pairs.T1_T5: Different RL datasets (30k versus 15k); do not interpret their delta as an SFT-only effect.

run_blockers.original_runtime_and_dependencies: REQUIRES_SERVER_VERIFICATION: supply immutable repository/backend revisions, complete environment, and resolved T1/T5 configs using the original hybrid stack.
run_blockers.original_oss_v3_reward: MISSING: obtain original rstg_oss_verifier_v3 source and dependencies; the old baseline reward is incompatible with the 30k mixture.
run_blockers.original_independent_validation: MISSING: obtain the original independent validation asset and record its immutable identity.
run_blockers.base_checkpoint_equivalence: REQUIRES_SERVER_VERIFICATION: the original T2 Base revision is unresolved; prove it equals the pinned T1/T5 Base revision or rerun T2 with that revision.
run_blockers.t5_sft_parent: MISSING: record the final SFT checkpoint, immutable revision, resolved SFT config, and log-reconciled SFT training volume before GRPO.
run_blockers.resolved_config_and_semantic_smoke: REQUIRES_SERVER_VERIFICATION: verify exact config propagation, original thought template, reward coverage, UID group size eight, masks/reductions, teacher-free GRPO mode, and optimizer-skip accounting before full training.
